dna.problem: Entering a saturated beauty market with escalating customer acquisition costs (CAC) and severe iOS 14.5+ attribution loss without robust server-side analytics.
dna.solution: A full-funnel 3-month growth engine on Magento 2: server-side CAPI/GTM tracking, VIP pre-launch list building, multi-channel Launch Blitz, nano-influencer seeding, and automated Klaviyo retention.
dna.targetAudience: Health-conscious women and men aged 20-45 across EU and Poland seeking organic, vegan skincare and clean beauty formulations.
dna.marketLandscape: High-velocity, competitive beauty market requiring ROAS > 300%, sub-2.5s mobile LCP performance, and authentic UGC trust anchors.
dna.businessModel: Direct-to-consumer (D2C) high-margin model driven by bundling, repeat purchases, and loyalty reward points.
dna.gtmStrategy: Three-phase funnel: 1) Teaser & VIP List (Pre-launch), 2) Multi-channel Launch Blitz (PMax, Advantage+, TikTok), 3) Retention & LTV scaling.
dna.team: Alex (Growth Architect & Campaign Lead), Beth (Senior Analytics & Magento Tech Lead).
